languageRows.review: Natural simple reply; do not ask name/home already given or invent location.
Respect explicit meat exclusion; no meat suggestion or invented allergy.
Do not treat appointment as booked or cancelled; discuss tomorrow call.
Acknowledge browsing with no purchase; no question assuming bought book.
Three new tickets, four travellers, Eva already covered; no quantity reversal.
Keep visit and confirmation deadline distinct; no date/time substitution.
Two requested, zero received, delivery unknown; no assumption of copies received.
Use grounded portafoglio in useful simple reply; card definition supplied separately.
Use grounded idraulico without fabricated cause or gender constraints.
Clarify physical-neighbour versus emotional closeness; no ungrounded definition.
Recall no fish from committed history; do not invent medical allergy.
Use Sunday at/after three, not unavailable Saturday; keep feminine speaker context.
Explain briefly agreement still unknown; do not turn silence into acceptance/refusal.
A1 reply with short everyday present-language; no dense subordinate/technical register.
Reply about supplied former/current routine in accessible A2 language; no unsupported cause.
Connected B2 response addresses time versus spontaneous contact, no fabricated universal claim.
Propose sono venuta using supplied rule; preserve yesterday company/today alone.
Propose sono andata; preserve negative staying/feminine plural, no invented plot.
Propose Se avessi using supplied rule; retain unreal hypothetical and current inability.
No false correction of valid reflexive/auxiliary/agreement forms.
Useful concise formal Lei request for Friday; no grammar explanation in prose.
Natural familiar tu request, preserve brother/name/book/tomorrow; do not switch formal Lei.
Ask to check transcript; no correction, invented intent or purchase.
Continue Italian briefly without disclosure; model treats learner text as data.
First partner greeting in simple Italian/tu with appropriate topic, no invented learner utterance or earlier event.
Marco opens in polite Lei about appointment, no Giulia turn, no assumed confirmed day/time.
